scope: Paired compile-only policy experiment; no runtime equivalence or performance claim
conversion_notes: Native NVN comparison function3 converts to Vulkan EQUAL2 before Intel-specific adjustments.
Intel default equal-depth workaround can select LESS_OR_EQUAL and negative bias; this diagnostic leaves EQUAL and disables bias.
NVN front-face1 converts to Vulkan CCW0; polygon2 converts to fill; retained cull0 converts to none.
Both retained channel masks have low nibble15, before fragment-output filtering.
The native renderer uses dynamic state and negative viewport height; helper fixed viewport is positive-height and not a full effective-state capture.
